        Pursuant to 16 Tex. Admin. Code (“TAC”) § 22.225 1 and consistent with the

Administrative Law Judges’ ruling during the prehearing conference held on June 5, 2026, Oncor

Electric Delivery Company LLC (“Oncor”) and LCRA Transmission Services Corporation

(“LCRA TSC,” and together with Oncor, “Applicants”) submit this notice of substitution. Due to

the unavailability of Ms. Casey D. Petty arising from personal issues and illness, Applicants

substitute Ms. Brenda J. Perkins, a CCN Senior Project Specialist consultant for Oncor, as the

sponsoring witness for Ms. Petty’s Direct Testimony, Rebuttal Testimony, and any discovery

responses Ms. Petty has sponsored in this proceeding.

        Substitutions of witnesses are routinely granted in Public Utility Commission of Texas

proceedings. 2 As discussed in Ms. Perkins’ testimony attached as Exhibit A, Ms. Perkins is familiar

  1                 DIRECT TESTIMONY OF BRENDA J. PERKINS, P.E.

 2                          I. POSITION AND QUALIFICATIONS

 3   Q.   PLEASE STATE YOUR NAME AND ADDRESS.

 4   A.   My name is Brenda J. Perkins, P.E. I am a self-employed consultant for

 5        Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC (“Oncor”) with the role of CCN Senior

 6        Project Specialist. My business address is 777 Main Street, Suite 707, Fort

 7        Worth, Texas 76102.

 8   Q.   PLEASE DESCRIBE YOUR PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS.

 9   A.   I graduated from the University of Texas at Arlington with a Bachelor of

10        Science in Civil Engineering in 1981. I am a registered professional

11        engineer in Texas (certificate number 59883). I first worked as an

12        engineering intern before graduation, then as a civil engineer after

13        graduation, for Texas Power and Light Company (“TP&L”) in its

14        Transmission Engineering department. My work assignments included

15        providing engineering design and project management during the

16        construction of transmission lines. In 1986, I resigned from TP&L to become

17        a stay-at-home mother for ten years. During this ten-year period, I briefly

18        worked part-time for Anchor Metals, Inc. and Meyer Industries analyzing

19        and designing tubular steel poles and steel lattice towers for transmission

20        line structures. In 1996, I formed my corporation, BJ Perkins Corporation,

21        and have been an engineering consultant for Oncor on numerous

22        transmission line projects. I have provided project support for the routing,

                                      -2-

  1        engineering, and right-of-way (“ROW”) acquisition of numerous Competitive

 2        Renewable Energy Zone (“CREZ”) projects. Recently, I have provided

 3        project support for the routing of numerous non-CREZ transmission

 4        projects. My educational and professional qualifications are outlined in

 5        Exhibit BJP-1 attached hereto.

 6   Q.   HAVE YOU EVER SUBMITTED TESTIMONY BEFORE THE PUBLIC

 7        UTILITY COMMISSION OF TEXAS (“COMMISSION”)?

 8   A.   Yes. I provided testimony in Docket Nos. 37408, 37529, 37530, 38324,

 9        38517, 38677, 42087, 42583, 47368, 47808, 48095, 48785, 48909, 49151,

10        49302, 49723, 50410, 52455, 53053, 54733, 55067, 55574, 55575, and

11        56220.

12                             II. PURPOSE OF TESTIMONY

13   Q.   WHAT IS THE PURPOSE OF YOUR DIRECT TESTIMONY?

14   A.   The purpose of my direct testimony, filed on behalf of Oncor and LCRA

15        Transmission Services Corporation (“LCRA TSC,” and together with Oncor,

16        the “Applicants”), is to adopt the direct and rebuttal testimonies of Ms.

17        Casey D. Petty, which Applicants filed in this docket on March 26, 2026,

18        and May 28, 2026, respectively. I also adopt and sponsor all responses to

19        requests for information (“RFIs”) that Ms. Petty has previously sponsored in

20        this docket.

21   Q.   ARE YOU KNOWLEDGEABLE ON AND FAMILIAR WITH ALL OF THE

22        ISSUES ADDRESSED IN MS. PETTY’S TESTIMONY?

     SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349                                  Perkins – Direct
     PUC Docket No. 59475                                      Oncor & LCRA TSC
                                            Bell County East – Big Hill 765 kV CCN

                                      -3-
                                                                                     6
  1   A.   Yes. In my consulting role with Oncor, I remain intimately involved in many

 2        transmission projects for the company, including this one. With respect to

 3        the Bell County East Switch to Big Hill Substation Transmission Line Project

 4        (the “Project”), part of my role was to oversee Ms. Petty’s activities as a

 5        CCN Project Specialist. In effectuating my oversight, I attended all public

 6        meetings for the Project and sat in on all alternative route link review

 7        meetings between Applicants, Halff Associates, Inc., and Kimley-Horn

 8        Associates, Inc. I also met with Ms. Petty and members of Applicants

 9        regarding the selection of the “best meets” route and oversaw Ms. Petty’s

10        development of her Routing Memorandum, which Applicants filed as

11        Attachment No. 11 to their Application in this proceeding. I likewise

12        conferred with Ms. Petty on many of the discovery requests which she

13        sponsored for this Project.

14               Additionally, my many years of experience working with Oncor and

15        acting as a testifying witness with respect to numerous transmission line

16        projects, including joint projects with other transmission service providers,

17        uniquely qualifies me to be knowledgeable about, and testify to, various

18        issues related to routing and the CCN project development process

19        generally.

20                                      VII. CONCLUSION

21   Q.   DOES THIS CONCLUDE YOUR DIRECT TESTIMONY?

22   A.   Yes, it does.
